message.content:
A medium tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
- Small tomatoes (≈90 g) have about 15–18 kcal.  
- Large tomatoes (≈150 g) have around 25–30 kcal.  

So, for most everyday uses, you can round to about **20 kcal per tomato**.
